name: Las Ventanas Al Paraiso
insider_take: Where desert meets sea in pure luxury - this Rosewood gem sits on one of Cabo's most pristine stretches of sand with unobstructed views of the Sea of Cortez.
whats_special: Las Ventanas features rooftop terraces with telescopes for stargazing, private beach access to Playa del Médano, and suites with infinity-edge hot tubs overlooking the ocean. The resort is famous for its tequila and mezcal collection - one of Mexico's most extensive with over 300 premium bottles.
pro_tip: Book the Ty Warner Penthouse's private chef experience during whale watching season (December-April) - gray whales migrate right past your terrace while you dine.
dont_miss: The signature spa treatment using indigenous Damiana herbs, sunset sailing to Land's End to see El Arco (the famous rock arch), and the Thursday night beach barbecue featuring local musicians and authentic Baja cuisine prepared in traditional underground pits.
pros: Stunning oceanfront location with panoramic Sea of Cortez views
Ultra-luxurious suites with private terraces and premium amenities
World-class spa with holistic wellness treatments
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Limited nightlife options within walking distance
